subject: general
question: Which leader will inaugurate the first edition of the SOUL Leadership Conclave on 21st February 2025 at Bharat Mandapam in Delhi?
solution:
The correct answer is Prime Minister Narendra Modi

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] __In News__**

__
 
• **PM Narendra Modi** to **inaugurate** the **first edition of the SOUL Leadership Conclave** on **21st February** at **Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **PM of Bhutan, Dasho Tshering Tobgay**, will be the **Guest of Honor** and deliver the **Keynote Address**.
 
• **The conclave will be held from 21st to 22nd February** and bring together **leaders from politics, sports, arts, media, spirituality, public policy, business, and social sectors**.
 
• The event will focus on **leadership, collaboration, thought leadership, and learning from both failures and successes** to **inspire young audiences**.
 
• **SOUL (School of Ultimate Leadership) is a new leadership institution in Gujarat** aimed at **advancing public good through authentic leadership**.
 
• The institution will **broaden India’s political leadership landscape** by offering **formal training** to those who rise through **merit, commitment, and passion for public service**, rather than **political lineage**.
 
• **SOUL will provide insights, skills, and expertise** to help leaders **navigate complex challenges** in today's world.
